description: The cabin starter template (templates/cabin.floorspec.json): a double-height living room under a one-sided vault that follows the shed roof above it, a bedroom, a bath and a kitchen under a sleeping loft, and a straight stair along the east wall whose head lands on the loft's railing; a deck slab. The roof is a shed of 3 in 12 rising from its south eave, its three other edges gables. The open part of the loft level is a bounded face with no room - the stair's well, and the living room's void - so FS-LINT-003 is reported for it; the stair has nothing above it, so it has no headroom.
